name: blueprint/artifact-publish
description: Build an artifact (page, diagram, sketch), publish it to R2 with rh_files_put, share it with a presigned URL, and notify - the render-to-share pipeline for anything the agent makes.
use_cases: a link the user can open
ingredients: rh_run to render/build the artifact (local tools)
recipe: render the artifact with rh_run (exit 0 = it exists) -> rh_files_put with the right contentType -> index record in the store { contentType, size, at } -> rh_files_share for the time-boxed link -> notify the link -> the URL is a secret for its window
result_kind: one R2 object + index record + presigned link
cost_hint: R2 storage on the user's account; rendering local
pitfalls: the presigned URL expires - share it, then it is gone
set contentType at put time or the browser renders it wrong
index record beside the blob (file-vault pattern)
rh_run verifies the artifact exists before put - exit 0 is the gate
